## 中文原文
午休时打算去楼下便利店买三明治。排队的时候收到同事消息，有紧急工作需要马上处理。只好放弃买午餐，赶回工位。

## My translation
I planned to buy a sandwitch at the convinence store downstairs during the lunch break.
While waiting in the line, I received some messages from my colleague, saying that some urgent work needed to be processed immediately.
So I had to give up buying the lunch and hurried back to the seat.

## Revised version
I planned to buy a sandwich at the convenience store downstairs during the lunch break.
While waiting in line, I received some messages from my colleague saying that some urgent work needed to be handled right away.
So I had to skip buying lunch and hurried back to the desk.

## Key phrases
- wait in line
- right away
- skip buying lunch
